description: Draft catalog of the mandatory blockers that GOV-000 section 10, GOV-022 section 22, GOV-023 section 28, SEC-007 section 30, QA-008 section 37, CICD-012 section 35 and DB-005 section 31 already require. Every control quotes one bullet of those lists verbatim. All controls are DRAFT with unassigned owners pending leadership approval; none has an automated verifier yet.
